meta.name: design-taste-frontend-v1
meta.description: The original v1 taste-skill, preserved for projects depending on its exact behavior. The current default is `design-taste-frontend` (v2 experimental), which is a substantial rewrite. Use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保留旧版设计品味，确保前端项目兼容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目依赖旧版设计品味技能的行为
copy.tagline_en: Preserve legacy design taste for frontend compatibility
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project depends on the exact behavior of the v1 design taste skill

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 生成的网页前端会遵循固定设计参数(创意度8、动效6、密度4):默认 React/Next.js + Tailwind,先核对依赖并提示安装;禁用 emoji,统一字体配色,补齐加载/空/错误状态,避开居中大标题、纯黑、三栏卡片等 AI 套路。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成或设计网页/前端界面(如 React、Next.js、Tailwind 页面)时触发;若项目需要精确的旧版 v1 行为,使用本安装名。

say.text: 用这个技能做一个落地页,分屏 Hero,左文右图。
say.note: 会生成不对称布局并检查依赖。

say.text: 给我个数据仪表盘,用 v1 规则,不要三栏卡片。
say.note: 强制避开常见套路,使用紧凑网格。

say.text: 设计移动端登录页,带加载和错误状态。
say.note: 会补全交互循环,且不用 emoji。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds UIs with fixed taste parameters (8/6/4). Defaults to React/Next.js + Tailwind; verifies dependencies, bans emojis, standardizes type/color, adds loading/empty/error states, avoids AI clichés.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for frontend/UI generation or design (e.g., React, Next.js, Tailwind pages), especially when v1 behavior is needed for backward compatibility.

say_en.text: Build a landing page with split-screen hero, text left, image right.
say_en.note: Produces an asymmetric layout and checks deps.

say_en.text: Make a data dashboard with v1 rules, no 3-column cards.
say_en.note: Enforces compact grids and avoids AI clichés.

say_en.text: Design a mobile login page with loading and error states.
say_en.note: Adds full interaction cycles, no emojis.
